notes:
Access: curl_cffi Chrome124 impersonation (per notes/220.md); robots.txt explicitly ALLOWs Claude bots, no escalation past tier-1 HTTP needed. Content confirmed English only. Marketplace scrutiny: Pepperfry is a multi-seller marketplace but this is Pepperfry's own site-level merchandising page (title/H1/meta all independently frame it as a clearance concept), not a per-listing seller badge. SALE VS CLEARANCE REASONING: found and rejected /category/clearance-sale.html (200, but its

is 'Home Utility' and its is 'Buy Home Utility at Best Prices Get Upto 65% Off | Pepperfry' - it is a generic Home Utility category page carrying a temporary %-off campaign banner, no clearance/outlet/last-chance language anywhere on the page; excluded as a generic discount campaign, not clearance taxonomy). By contrast /discover/clearance-sale.html (a DIFFERENT URL) passes the clearance test: <title>Prime Clearance Sale on Furniture @ Pepperfry and, critically,

Last Chance to Buy

- 'Last Chance' is one of the brief's own target clearance terms, and this is the site's own heading for the page (not a badge on a PDP), so it was recorded as valid Clearance rather than flagged ambiguous. Also confirmed this URL IS linked as a live banner tile from furniture.html and sofas-and-seating.html (unlike the Bestsellers find), reinforcing it is a real, currently-promoted site feature. Also rejected as non-clearance after inspection: /discover/Limited-Time-Limited-Stock.html (200, H1 'Limited Time Limited Stock', 200 products) - explicitly time-bound ('Limited Time'), no clearance/outlet/final-sale/last-chance wording, reads as a temporary flash-deal campaign rather than permanent markdown/outlet stock, and does not match any brief target term, so excluded outright rather than flagged; /discover/furnishings-sale-deals.html (title references a festival 'Billion Sale', clearly a seasonal promotional campaign, excluded); /discover/deals-home-kitchen-offer.html (generic 'deals/offer' page, no clearance signal, excluded). Checked: main nav (no Clearance/Outlet nav item across the 9 top-level verticals), footer (Popular Categories only), sitemap-index.xml (11 vertical sitemaps + generic website.xml, no dedicated clearance sitemap/URL), direct URL probing (/clearance.html, /category/clearance.html, /category/outlet.html, /discover/clearance.html, /discover/outlet.html, /discover/outlet-store.html, /discover/final-sale.html, /discover/end-of-line.html, /discover/discontinued.html, /discover/last-chance.html, /discover/clearance-store.html, /discover/end-of-season-sale.html - all 404), and banner-tile cross-check across furniture/home-decor/lighting/kitchen-dining/sofas-and-seating/mattresses/luxury/furnishings/dining-tables/beds category pages. Page validated as a genuine PLP via item-list-structured-data JSON-LD showing real furniture products (Athena Ergonomic Chair, Kane Fabric 3 Seater Sofa, Casio Office Chair, Sawara Upholstered Queen Bed, etc.), not editorial content. Only one clearance listing found; no genuine site-exposed sub-structure, so no grouping row.
